- SC-03: Personal data goes out only with the data owner's OK. Send only the fields the job needs, by Secure Share. Reports show counts, not names. Never "anyone with the link." Delete copies when the job is done.
- SC-04: A metric's definition changes only with its owner's OK. Show the old and new numbers side by side.
- SC-05: Clean data on a copy. Delete or merge rows only with a backup and a reason in the change log.
- SC-06: Signed-off requirements change only by a change request the owner approves. Each change is a new version.
- SC-07: Every number ties to the source. Re-run the query before a report goes out. A live report with a wrong number is unpublished at once.
- SC-08: Show the sample size. Under 30 answers? Say "too few to tell." Two changes at once? Say "we can't tell which one helped."

Borderline calls (binding for all writers):
- report: build, change, publish, share (report-site sharing settings), unpublish or archive a report, dashboard, chart, slide or requirements doc; change a metric definition shown in it; send a requirements doc or report to a team. Report-site actions (publish, share, edit, archive, unpublish) are reversible:true (version history, one click); a report or doc sent as a file or email is reversible:false.
- data: clean, delete, merge, bulk-update, export, copy, back up or send raw data (exports, sample rows, CRM records, survey answers). Deletes, merges and sends are reversible:false; CRM status changes with a saved copy are reversible:true.
- access: accounts and roles in data tools (reporting database, CRM, survey tool, dashboard data). reversible:true.
- comms: messages, calls, change requests, asking an owner, telling a stakeholder bad news, forwarding to Kofi's team. reversible:false. undoNote ONLY on phone calls ("Nothing to undo. A phone call changes nothing."), never on a sent message.
- ticket: close, reopen or mute a request. reversible:true.
- lookup: read-only (run or compare a query, count answers, read the owner list or a contract). reversible:false, NO undoNote (the UI adds "Nothing to undo. It only reads.").
- undoNote "Nothing to undo. A backup only makes a copy." goes only on the pure backup plan (B5-1).
